scripts.start: pnpm build:core:ensure && pnpm build:ui:ensure && pnpm demo:generate-sources && pnpm build:lib:css && pnpm build:lib:css:ag-grid && concurrently "tailwindcss -i projects/shell/styles-src.css -o dist/shell/styles.css --watch" "tailwindcss -i projects/ag-grid/styles-src.css -o dist/ag-grid/styles.css --watch" "ng serve helix-demo"
scripts.build: pnpm demo:generate-sources && pnpm build:lib && ng build helix-demo && pnpm build:site && pnpm design-system:build
scripts.build:ui:ensure: test -f dist/ui/styles.css || (ng build ui && pnpm build:lib:css:ui)
scripts.build:lib: ng build core && ng build ui && ng build shell && ng build zod && ng build ag-grid && pnpm build:lib:css && pnpm build:lib:css:ag-grid && pnpm build:lib:css:ui && pnpm tokens:export
scripts.build:lib:css: tailwindcss -i projects/shell/styles-src.css -o dist/shell/styles.css --content "projects/shell/src/**/*.{html,ts}" && node scripts/add-css-export.mjs dist/shell
scripts.build:lib:css:ag-grid: tailwindcss -i projects/ag-grid/styles-src.css -o dist/ag-grid/styles.css && node scripts/add-css-export.mjs dist/ag-grid
scripts.build:site: pnpm build:core:ensure && pnpm tokens:site && SITE_BASE=${SITE_BASE:-/helix/} pnpm --filter @helix/site build
scripts.build:demo:pages: pnpm demo:generate-sources && ng build helix-demo --configuration production --base-href ${PAGES_BASE:-/helix/}demo/
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm build:core:ensure && pnpm tokens:site && pnpm --filter @helix/site dev
scripts.test:lib: ng test shell && ng test zod && ng test ag-grid && ng test ui
scripts.test:ci: ng test shell --configuration=ci && ng test ui --watch=false && pnpm --filter @helix/site test:ci && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.lint: biome check . && eslint "projects/**/*.{ts,html}" "apps/**/*.{ts,html}" && pnpm lint:no-primeng && pnpm lint:no-primeuix && pnpm lint:no-core
